ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central longitudinal axis and the entirety of the upper trailing margin consist of contiguous low-intensity black pixels. Lateral distal regions exhibit high-intensity white backgrounds heavily populated with irregular low-intensity pixel clusters, mottling, and focal circular spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50-60 degrees and a pixel depth approximately 1/5th of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration map. Trailing edge displays continuous irregular jagged geometry with prominent peaks and valleys, particularly concentrated on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral convex curves sweeping upwards and outwards from the median notch, terminating in sharp, non-rounded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple annular (ring-shaped) high-contrast pixel clusters detected. A distinct cluster of roughly 8-10 rings is located on the mid-ventral region of the left lobe; additional scattered rings are visible near the right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe, including a prominent diagonal line bisecting a white patch and several shorter, parallel vertical disruptions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks on the right lobe and dense clusters of circular barnacle attachment scars distributed across the high-intensity pigmented regions of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and dense 'salt-and-pepper' mottling transition zone between the solid black trailing margin and the white distal regions.
